thread:
jess: quick heads up — opened PR to tighten k8s SA for the onprem sidecar (drops default secrets access). https://git.company/repo/pull/4287 please review when you have a sec

sophie: thanks — linking. does this change affect the VPC egress rules or require new network policies?

jess: good q. no new egress rules. sidecar still talks outbound to metrics & kms via the existing NAT path. only change is RBAC scope: ServiceAccount now only gets `secrets.get` on our sidecar-secret, not cluster-wide secrets.list

marco: can you paste the RBAC snippet? want to check for any kube2iam role mappings that might break our instance-profile assumptions

jess: sure — snippet below
```
kind: Role
apiVersion: rbac.authorization.k8s.io/v1
metadata:
  name: sidecar-minimal
rules:
- apiGroups: [""]
  resources: ["secrets"]
  verbs: ["get"]
  resourceNames: ["sidecar-secret"]
```

jess: we also added a migration job to copy any legacy cluster-level secrets consumers to the new sidecar-secret (job will run once during deploy, idempotent)

security-bot: automated-scan: secrets-scan: ✅ no leaked tokens found in PR diff. SCA: 1 low finding (unused dep)

sophie: 👍 can you add a note in the PR description about the migration job + rollback plan? ops will want the exact command if we need to revert quickly

jess: done — added deployment steps + rollback command. rollback is `kubectl -n infra delete job sidecar-migrate || true` then revert the SA binding

devops: merge window today at 16:00 UTC. are we asking for an immediate canary or full rollout?

jess: planning a canary to 10% traffic for 30m then ramp. if the migration job fails we'll auto-rollback (job emits metric and deploy job uses `--on-failure=rollback`)

marco: LGTM from my side on RBAC. did you run smoke locally against an airgapped cluster?

jess: ran smoke in staging (`staging-onprem`) — logs in PR comments. one minor flake on metrics export, but not related to auth.

sophie: +1 from security after the migration note and explicit secret resourceNames. small nit: can we squash the extra debug commit?

jess: will squash on merge. requesting final approval: @marco @devops please? :pray:

marco: approving now. :white_check_mark:

devops: approving for canary deploy window. remind me 10m before deploy so I can watch egress metrics

jess: thanks all — will kick off canary at 16:00 UTC and ping here 10m prior

security-bot: policy-check: authz policy passes (no privileged escalation paths detected)

marco: small follow-up: add a short line in the ops-runbook about how to verify the migrate job succeeded (metric name: `sidecar_migrate_success{job="sidecar-migrate"}`)

jess: added runbook blurb. last call for objections — none heard, merging at scheduled window. :rocket:
